## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-*juan* Northern-Sòng running subcommentary on [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān yìlì* ([KR6d0132](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0132), T1913) by [處元](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%99%95%E5%85%83) Chǔyuán (1030–1119) of the *shānjiā* lineage. The genre — *suíshì* 隨釋 ("following-explanation") — indicates a continuous commentary that follows the source-text *pari passu*, providing systematic phrase-by-phrase exposition. Parallel in genre and period to [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) Cóngyì's *Yìlì zuǎnyào* ([KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139)).

**Abstract**

Chǔyuán's *Suíshì* and Cóngyì's *Zuǎnyào* together represent the two principal Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* subcommentaries on Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān yìlì* — both works compositionally located in the productive period 1060–1119. The two subcommentaries' parallel existence demonstrates the substantial Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* scholastic engagement with the *Zhǐguān yìlì*, parallel to the multi-commentary tradition on the *Móhē zhǐguān* itself ([KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131), [KR6d0137](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0137), [KR6d0138](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0138)).

The composition is bracketed within Chǔyuán's productive period c. 1060–1119.
